name: emit
description: Report a short summary and finish this turn. On the call that ends the whole job, set finish=true and put the full consolidated report in summary -- that single call ends the job and is the deliverable.

parameters.name: summary
parameters.description: one line for a normal round; the FULL final report when finish=true

parameters.name: finish
parameters.description: true only on the call that ends the whole job, when every dispatched file has been reported
